scoring_justification: Recomputing orbital overlaps and spins from raw QC output is infeasible in a lightweight checker; instead we verify structural relationships (ordering, magnitude ranges) that directly support the paper’s central claim of pronounced singlet biradical character and a small cyclization barrier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Structural thresholds for biradical and energetic checks derived from the paper’s reported values.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2, Fig. 1, and textual description of orbital overlaps and spin populations.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hand‑selected bounds based on the paper’s reported numbers, widened to accommodate legitimate toolchain spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The bounds capture the essential qualitative picture (small S_π for Si, larger for C; high localized spins on Si and terminal O; normal σ overlaps; small barrier; large exothermicity). Any honest reproduction will satisfy them while trivial answers (e.g., extremely large overlaps, zero spins, zero barrier) are excluded.

required.H2SiOO_GVB_overlaps: object with keys S_pi, S_Si_Oa, S_Oa_Ob (all float)
required.H2SiOO_CASSCF_spins: object with keys Si, O_terminal (both float)
required.H2COO_GVB_overlaps: object with keys S_pi, S_C_Oa, S_Oa_Ob (all float)
required.H2COO_CASSCF_spins: object with keys C, O_terminal (both float)

outputs.description: Aggregated reproduction results: MP2 energies and structural flags, GVB orbital overlaps, and CASSCF effective localized spin populations for H₂SiOO and H₂COO.

output_contract.notes: All numeric fields are compared to hidden reference values from the original study using absolute tolerances appropriate for a re-run with a different quantum chemistry package.

steps.description: Structural validation of biradical character and reaction energetics: checks ordering and magnitude bounds on orbital overlaps, spin populations, barrier height, exothermicity, and the imaginary frequency flag.
